Description: Members find a book by ISBN and see whether a copy is available, quickly.
As a Student Member, I want to search the catalog by ISBN, so that I can find the exact book I need.
As a Student Member, I want to see whether each copy is on the shelf or on loan and how many members are waiting, so that I know whether I need to place a hold.
As a Student Member, I want to search by title or author when I do not know the ISBN, so that I can still find the book.
As a Head Librarian, I want to search results to be indexed and paginated, so that a search over 50,000 titles returns in under 150 ms.
Members join a fair FIFO waitlist for loaned books, see their place and can leave the queue.
As a Student Member, I want to place a hold on a book that is on loan, so that I join its waitlist.
As a Head Librarian, I want to the system to stop a member holding more than the maximum number of holds, so that popular books are shared fairly.
As a Student Member, I want to my place in the queue to follow the order in which I asked, even when many members ask at once, so that the queue is fair.
As a Student Member, I want to see my position for each hold, so that I know how long I may wait.
As a Student Member, I want to cancel a hold I no longer need, so that the members behind me move up.
A returned copy is offered to the first member in the queue and reserved for them.
As a Head Librarian, I want to record a returned book, so that the copy can go to the next member.
As a Student Member, I want to be notified by email and in-app within 5 minutes when my book is returned, so that I can collect it quickly.
As a Student Member, I want to the copy to be kept for me for 48 hours, so that I have time to collect it.
As a Student Member, I want to the copy to be offered to me when the member ahead does not collect it, so that books are not left idle on the hold shelf.
Late returns are fined consistently and members can pay online.
As a Head Librarian, I want to fines calculated at Rs. 5 per day per book, capped at Rs. 500, so that late returns are charged consistently.
As a Student Member, I want to see my fines on my account, so that I know what I owe.
As a Student Member, I want to pay by card, UPI or net banking, so that I do not need to visit the desk.
As a Student Member, I want to get a receipt with the book, amount and date, so that I have proof of payment.
As a Head Librarian, I want to waive or reduce a fine and record the reason, so that genuine cases are treated fairly.
